title: Website
description: A complete website in your brand colours, ready to publish: home, about, services, gallery, reviews, questions and contact.

intro.title: Create your brand's website in one click
intro.body: We build a complete website from your project: name, slogan, mission, logo, colours, fonts and contact details. You then adjust every text and publish.
features: Home, about, services, gallery, testimonials, questions and contact
Contact form: messages arrive here and by email
WhatsApp button, mobile menu, SEO and sharing image
Public address with your name, QR code and ZIP export
intro.noLogo: The website uses your visual identity: create a logo first.
intro.viewerOnly: An editor or the workspace owner can create the website.

created: Your website is ready: adjust the texts, then publish it.
readOnly: Read only: only editors and the owner can change the website.

preview.label: Website preview
preview.noLogo: The project no longer has a logo: create one to display the website.

fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Tagline

fields.author: Name
fields.question: Question
fields.formHint: Messages arrive in the Messages tab and by email.
fields.imagesHint: Up to 16 images: mockups of your logo or uploaded photos.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.whatsappHint: International number: shows the floating WhatsApp button.

seo.title: Search engines
seo.pageTitleHint: Shown in the browser tab and search results.
seo.pageDescriptionHint: One or two sentences: shown under the title in Google and when the link is shared.

images.tooLarge: Photo up to 4 MB (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
images.badType: Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP.

style.fromLogo: Use the logo's colours and fonts
style.heading: Headings

style.credit: “Website made with Marka” notice in the footer
style.creditFree: Included in the free plan: switch to a paid plan to remove it.

publish.slugHint: 3 to 48 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
publish.unpublished: The website is no longer online
publish.views: {count, plural, =0 {No visits} one {# visit} other {# visits}}
publish.notPublished: The website is not online yet: publish it to make it visible.
publish.dirtyHint: Your latest changes are not visible online yet.
publish.qrHint: Print it on your cards, flyers and shop windows.
publish.exportHint: A self-contained folder to host anywhere (Netlify, cPanel, GitHub Pages…). The form keeps sending messages here.
publish.exportFree: Export is included in paid plans.
publish.exportReady: Archive ready: the download is starting.
publish.deleteConfirm: The website, its photos and its messages will be permanently deleted. The address will become available again.
publish.mockNotice: Demo mode: “View the website” opens the page in a new tab, without a public address.

messages.title: Messages received
